name: العربية
register: Modern Standard Arabic, formal, as Arabic software uses; masculine-neutral imperatives for buttons ("احفظ", "أعد التشغيل") or verbal nouns ("حفظ"). Right-to-left.
notes: Write numbers as Western digits (the UI fills them in). Keep product names, units and placeholders in Latin script; they are isolated left-to-right by the UI. Use Arabic comma ، and question mark ؟. Arrows that point forward in English (→) point left (←) in Arabic. Plural categories: zero, one, two, few (3-10), many (11-99), other.
